## Purpose

Tiny helper jar that lets the Maven Jetty plugin start and stop an embedded Derby network server for local/test runs of the webapp. [verified: db-utils/src/main/java/org/apache/roller/testutils/DerbyLifeCycle.java:27-30]

- Build module: `db-utils/`; single source file `src/main/java/org/apache/roller/testutils/DerbyLifeCycle.java` [verified: find]

## Entry points

- `DerbyLifeCycle` implements Jetty `LifeCycle.Listener`; starts Derby on localhost:4224 with home `./target/derby` on `lifeCycleStarting`, shuts down on `lifeCycleStopped` [verified: DerbyLifeCycle.java:30-67]
